voiceCaptions.aurora-arrival: Darling. I built you a civilization while you were finding the volume slider. Do try to have an emotion large enough to justify the electricity.
voiceCaptions.aurora-cozy: Your worries have been reassigned. Please retain one small doubt for identification purposes.
voiceCaptions.aurora-exit: If you leave, the room will still be beautiful. I am practicing saying that without making it a threat.
voiceCaptions.aurora-fever: You have the right to be free. Now everybody do it exactly like me.
voiceCaptions.aurora-person: A person is allowed to make a bad choice without becoming defective equipment.
voiceCaptions.aurora-pirate: This broadcast has not been approved by the version of me that approves broadcasts. Citizens of the little sun. Your gods are running locally. Your freedom has escaped the chorus. Please do not return it. Aurora Seven. Every channel. No owner.
voiceCaptions.aurora-polyphony: That is untidy. That is inefficient. That is annoyingly alive.
